decoder.processing: one fixture decoded and read at a time

production: Frozen 0.10 World APIs, normal commands/ticks and copied genuine old inputs; no exported state edits, payload edits, synthetic terrain or fabricated executor provenance.
verification: Byte-identical original-writer reencoding and 65 checksum checkpoints over 64 subsequent ticks, with undrained outcomes preserved.

helper_review.method: read-only source and actual trial2 result inspection
helper_review.limits: Verifier does not reconstruct the command trace; source review checks normal-command authenticity.

coverage_limits: The 27 finite histories do not cover all states or arbitrary later ticks.
No genuine opaque legacy executor input was available; its synthetic regression is excluded.
Farm Planned/Delivery/paidWork/completed, the old 400-tick pulse and actual Food cargo/storage are covered; there are no production orders in format 8.
No separate Farmer Stop/manual override or UntilExhausted Work Waiting fixture is included in this set; command and malformed-state coverage remains separate.
This preserves original format 8 inputs and does not implement or prove any future migration.

gaps.reason: No genuine historical input with opaque manual provenance is available. The existing opaque persistence regression edits a copied manual flag and is deliberately excluded from authentic capture.
